lines: Two columns on the board. CARRIED came up the road, FLOWN came in over the gorge.
Flown is four times the price and it is worth it about a third of the time.
The third of the time is the bit people remember, which is how I stay in business.
Aurelian glass out of Tideglass. Not Aurelian, obviously. Aurelian STYLE. Read the card.
The real stuff is in a museum in the capital and it is four thousand years old and it is not cloudy.
Mine is cloudy. Mine is also nine hundred times cheaper. Choose.
Nothing has come up the coast in a fortnight. Not one boat, not one crate, not one word.
They are not sunk. Somebody would know. They are TIED UP, which is worse.
Fishermen do not tie up for a fortnight. Fishermen tie up for two days and complain.
Off the eleven o clock from Tideglass and still cold when it got here. Ask me how.
Ice, straw, and four hundred feet of cold air on the way up. That is how.
Three hundred miles from the sea and I sell the freshest fish in the region. I love this city.
Everything here is either from three streets away or from another region. Nothing in between.
There is no in between. There is no countryside. There is a plateau and then there is a drop.
